Chapter 7: The Malala Fund and a Movement for Change
As her voice grows stronger, Malala and her family start thinking about how they can turn their passion into something that lasts. So, they decide to create a foundation—one with a big, bold mission: to support education for girls, everywhere. That’s how the Malala Fund is born.
But this isn’t just another charity. It’s a movement—a promise to fight for every child’s right to learn, no matter where they live.
Of course, the work isn’t easy. There are endless forms to fill out, tough cultural barriers to break through, and sometimes, even the threat of violence lurking in the background. But then, there are those moments that make it all worthwhile—a new school opening its doors in a far-off village, or a scholarship given to a girl who never imagined she’d get the chance to study. Sometimes, it’s simply a community coming together, ready to support its children’s dreams.
Every little victory, every life touched, is proof that change actually is possible.
Malala travels to places where education is under threat. She sits down with students, teachers, and local leaders, really listening to their stories and learning from their struggles. In refugee camps, she meets children who have lost almost everything—but who still hold onto hope. In packed classrooms, she encourages girls to dream bigger, to believe in their own potential, even when the odds seem stacked against them.
But here’s the thing: the Malala Fund isn’t just about building schools or handing out books. It’s about challenging the beliefs and systems that keep kids—especially girls—from getting an education in the first place. Malala and her team push for changes in policy, team up with local organizations, and use their voice to raise awareness about why education matters so much.
They know the journey is far from over. But they’re in it for the long haul.
Through everything, Malala stays grounded by her family and her faith. She holds on to the lessons she learned as a child—the importance of kindness, sticking with it when things get tough, and always, always holding onto hope.
She’s well aware the road ahead won’t be easy. But this time, she isn’t walking alone. The movement she’s helped create is growing, fueled by the dreams and determination of people all over the world.
And that’s what makes real change possible.
